verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־ שֹׁ֭שַׁנִּים מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֑רַח יְדִידֹֽת׃ שִׁ֣יר לִבִּ֨י׀ רָ֘חַ֤שׁ ט֗וֹב דָּ֘בָ֤ר אָ֭נִי אֹמֵ֣ר מַעֲשַׂ֣י לְמֶ֑לֶךְ לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י עֵ֤ט׀ מָהִֽיר׃ סוֹפֵ֬ר
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘a·lō·šō- šan·nîm maś·kîl liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ yə·ḏî·ḏōṯ šîr lib·bî rā·ḥaš ṭō·wḇ dā·ḇār ’ā·nî ’ō·mêr ma·‘ă·śay lə·me·leḵ lə·šō·w·nî ‘êṭ mā·hîr sō·w·p̄êr
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of The Lilies A Maskil of the sons of Korah A love song My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer

verses.original: יָפְיָפִ֡יתָ מִבְּנֵ֬י אָדָ֗ם חֵ֭ן ה֣וּצַק בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶ֑יךָ עַל־ כֵּ֤ן אֱלֹהִ֣ים בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·p̄ə·yā·p̄î·ṯā mib·bə·nê ’ā·ḏām ḥên hū·ṣaq bə·śə·p̄ə·ṯō·w·ṯe·ḵā ‘al- kên ’ĕ·lō·hîm bê·raḵ·ḵā lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: You are the most handsome of men . . . grace has anointed your lips therefore . . . God has blessed you forever . . .

verses.original: חֲגֽוֹר־ חַרְבְּךָ֣ עַל־ יָרֵ֣ךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ וַהֲדָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḡō·wr- ḥar·bə·ḵā ‘al- yā·rêḵ gib·bō·wr hō·wḏ·ḵā wa·hă·ḏā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Strap your sword at your side O mighty warrior appear in your majesty and splendor

verses.original: וַהֲדָ֬רְךָ֨׀ רְכַ֗ב צְלַ֬ח עַֽל־ דְּבַר־ אֱ֭מֶת וְעַנְוָה־ צֶ֑דֶק יְמִינֶֽךָ׃ וְתוֹרְךָ֖ נוֹרָא֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ḏā·rə·ḵā rə·ḵaḇ ṣə·laḥ ‘al- də·ḇar- ’ĕ·meṯ wə·‘an·wāh- ṣe·ḏeq yə·mî·ne·ḵā wə·ṯō·wr·ḵā nō·w·rā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice may your right hand show your awesome deeds

verses.original: חִצֶּ֗יךָ שְׁנ֫וּנִ֥ים בְּ֝לֵ֗ב הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ אוֹיְבֵ֥י עַ֭מִּים יִפְּל֑וּ תַּחְתֶּ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: ḥiṣ·ṣe·ḵā šə·nū·nîm bə·lêḇ ham·me·leḵ ’ō·wy·ḇê ‘am·mîm yip·pə·lū taḥ·te·ḵā
verses.literal: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes the nations fall beneath your feet

verses.original: כִּסְאֲךָ֣ אֱ֭לֹהִים עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד שֵׁ֥בֶט מִ֝ישֹׁ֗ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kis·’ă·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ šê·ḇeṭ mî·šōr šê·ḇeṭ mal·ḵū·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Your throne O God [endures] forever and ever [and] justice [is] the scepter of Your kingdom

verses.original: אָהַ֣בְתָּ צֶּדֶק֮ וַתִּשְׂנָ֫א רֶ֥שַׁע עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֶיךָ מְשָׁחֲךָ֡ מֵֽחֲבֵרֶֽיךָ׃ שֶׁ֥מֶן שָׂשׂ֗וֹן
verses.transliteration: ’ā·haḇ·tā ṣe·ḏeq wat·tiś·nā re·ša‘ ‘al- kên ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mə·šā·ḥă·ḵā mê·ḥă·ḇê·re·ḵā še·men śā·śō·wn
verses.literal: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness therefore . . . God your God has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy

verses.original: כָּל־ בִּגְדֹתֶ֑יךָ מֹר־ וַאֲהָל֣וֹת קְ֭צִיעוֹת מִֽן־ הֵ֥יכְלֵי שֵׁ֝֗ן מִנִּ֥י שִׂמְּחֽוּךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- biḡ·ḏō·ṯe·ḵā mōr- wa·’ă·hā·lō·wṯ qə·ṣî·‘ō·wṯ min- hê·ḵə·lê šēn min·nî śim·mə·ḥū·ḵā
verses.literal: All your garments [are fragrant] with myrrh and aloes and cassia from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad

verses.original: בְּנ֣וֹת מְ֭לָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ שֵׁגַ֥ל נִצְּבָ֥ה לִֽ֝ימִינְךָ֗ בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nō·wṯ mə·lā·ḵîm bə·yiq·qə·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā šê·ḡal niṣ·ṣə·ḇāh lî·mî·nə·ḵā bə·ḵe·ṯem ’ō·w·p̄îr
verses.literal: The daughters of kings are among your honored women the queen stands at your right hand adorned with the gold of Ophir

verses.original: שִׁמְעִי־ בַ֣ת וּ֭רְאִי וְהַטִּ֣י אָזְנֵ֑ךְ וְשִׁכְחִ֥י עַ֝מֵּ֗ךְ אָבִֽיךְ׃ וּבֵ֥ית
verses.transliteration: šim·‘î- ḇaṯ ū·rə·’î wə·haṭ·ṭî ’ā·zə·nêḵ wə·šiḵ·ḥî ‘am·mêḵ ’ā·ḇîḵ ū·ḇêṯ
verses.literal: Listen O daughter Consider and incline your ear Forget your people and your father’s house

verses.original: הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ וְיִתְאָ֣ו יָפְיֵ֑ךְ וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי־ לֽוֹ׃ כִּי־ ה֥וּא אֲ֝דֹנַ֗יִךְ
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ wə·yiṯ·’āw yā·p̄ə·yêḵ wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wî- lōw kî- hū ’ă·ḏō·na·yiḵ
verses.literal: and the king will desire your beauty bow to him for he is your lord

verses.original: וּבַֽת־ צֹ֨ר׀ בְּ֭מִנְחָה עָֽם׃ עֲשִׁ֣ירֵי יְחַלּ֗וּ פָּנַ֥יִךְ
verses.literal: The Daughter of Tyre [will come] with a gift men of wealth will seek your favor

verses.original: כָּל־ כְּבוּדָּ֣ה בַת־ פְּנִ֑ימָה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃ מִֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב
verses.transliteration: kāl- kə·ḇū·dāh ḇaṯ- pə·nî·māh me·leḵ lə·ḇū·šāh mim·miš·bə·ṣō·wṯ zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: All glorious is the princess in her chamber . . . her gown [is] embroidered with gold

verses.original: לִרְקָמוֹת֮ תּוּבַ֪ל לַ֫מֶּ֥לֶךְ בְּתוּל֣וֹת רֵעוֹתֶ֑יהָ אַ֭חֲרֶיהָ מ֖וּבָא֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lir·qā·mō·wṯ tū·ḇal lam·me·leḵ bə·ṯū·lō·wṯ rê·‘ō·w·ṯe·hā ’a·ḥă·re·hā mū·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lāḵ
verses.literal: In colorful garments she is led to the king her virgin companions . . . are brought before you

verses.original: תּ֭וּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹ֣ת וָגִ֑יל תְּ֝בֹאֶ֗ינָה בְּהֵ֣יכַל מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: tū·ḇal·nāh biś·mā·ḥōṯ wā·ḡîl tə·ḇō·’e·nāh bə·hê·ḵal me·leḵ
verses.literal: They are led in with joy and gladness they enter the palace of the king

verses.original: בָנֶ֑יךָ תַּ֣חַת יִהְי֣וּ אֲ֭בֹתֶיךָ תְּשִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ לְ֝שָׂרִ֗ים בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ḇā·ne·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ yih·yū ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā tə·šî·ṯê·mōw lə·śā·rîm bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Your sons will succeed . . . your fathers you will make them princes throughout the land

verses.original: אַזְכִּ֣ירָה שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל־ דֹּ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר עַל־ כֵּ֥ן עַמִּ֥ים יְ֝הוֹדֻ֗ךָ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’az·kî·rāh šim·k̲ā bə·ḵāl dōr wā·ḏōr ‘al- kên ‘am·mîm yə·hō·w·ḏu·ḵā lə·‘ō·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: I will commemorate your name through all generations . . . therefore . . . the nations will praise you forever and ever
